meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让关键计划在敲定前先经受多方挑刺与交叉质疑,变得更扎实
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你制定关键计划时希望有人从对立角度帮你查漏补缺,而不是只收获附和。
copy.tagline_en: Toughen up your plan by running it past a hostile review team before you commit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you own important plans and want them to survive hostile scrutiny before being locked in.

howto.what: 启动后 Claude 会先说「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」,充当 5 人对抗团队的 Lead,让成员互相批判彼此的发现,只留下经得起攻击的洞察,再交给专门的 planner 写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当你要求做 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批判式计划,或规划需要极高严谨性时触发;需 lead 团队工具可用,且当前会话是顶层 lead。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这次数据库迁移
对这份方案做对抗式交叉批判,然后给我正式计划
say.note: 成员互相攻击发现,存活下来的洞察才被采纳。

say.text: 换个题目:用 hyperplan 重做定价策略计划
say.note: 同一流程,针对新对象重新开一轮对抗批判。

howto.what_en: On load Claude says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!" and acts as Lead of a 5-member adversarial team whose members attack each other's findings; only defensible insights survive and pass to a dedicated planner for formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a hyperplan, adversarial or cross-critique plan, or when planning needs maximum rigor. Requires the lead team tools and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan our database migration
say_en.note: Claude spawns 5 adversarial members, then a planner formalizes it.

say_en.text: Run an adversarial cross-critique on this plan, then give me the formal version
say_en.note: Members attack each other's findings; only survivors are kept.

say_en.text: New topic: redo this pricing strategy plan with hyperplan
say_en.note: Same flow, a fresh adversarial round for the new object.
